business.name: Bluebird Plumbing & Heating
business.tagline: Fast, honest plumbing and heating service in Portland
business.description: Bluebird Plumbing & Heating is a licensed, family-owned plumbing and heating company serving the Portland metro area since 2012. Upfront pricing, same-week appointments, and 24/7 emergency service.
business.hoursText: Mon-Fri 7:30 AM-6:00 PM, Sat 9:00 AM-2:00 PM, closed Sunday. 24/7 emergency service.

services.name: Drain cleaning
services.description: Clogged sinks, tubs, and main lines cleared with professional augers and hydro-jetting.

services.name: Water heater repair & installation
services.description: Tank and tankless water heater diagnosis, repair, and same-week replacement.

services.name: Leak detection & pipe repair
services.description: Electronic leak detection, burst pipe repair, and repiping.

services.name: Furnace & heating repair
services.description: Furnace tune-ups, repairs, and thermostat installation.

services.name: Fixture installation
services.description: Faucets, toilets, garbage disposals, and shower valves installed.

services.name: Emergency plumbing (24/7)
services.description: Burst pipes, sewage backups, and no-hot-water emergencies, day or night.

pricing.serviceCallFeeNote: The $79 service call fee is waived when you approve the recommended repair.
notes: All prices are upfront, flat-rate quotes given before work begins — never hourly surprises.
Free estimates on repiping and water heater replacement jobs.
Senior and military discount: 10% off labor.

extraFacts: All technicians are background-checked employees, never subcontractors.
